overall: Washington, DC is starting the day clear (CLR/SKC) and humid at 71.6°F with a dewpoint of 68°F, well below the expected afternoon peak. South winds are light and warming should accelerate through the morning into early afternoon. A regional Heat Advisory is in effect and an Extreme Heat Watch covers portions of nearby Maryland and Virginia, reinforcing a notably hot airmass in place.
forecast_obs_notes: NWP models show meaningful spread: ECMWF (89.3°F) and NBM (88.7°F) cluster tightly near 89°F, while HRRR runs 4°F hotter at 92.9°F. max_temp_prediction: The weight of evidence — NWS 'near 90,' ECMWF 89.3, NBM 88.7 — points to a TMAX landing in the 88–91°F range, with the 88-89°F and 90-91°F even buckets being the most competitive. Overall confidence is moderate given the ~4°F inter-model spread.
